title: Programmable Stamp-Form Manufacturing
license: All rights reserved pending IP review
abstract: STAMPFORM describes a programmable transfer process in which material behavior, stamp geometry, contact, release, and fixation form one testable manufacturing loop.

title: Material Images Through Direct Pigment Transfer
license: All rights reserved pending IP review
abstract: Oil Print treats pigment composition, transparency, relief, texture, and registration as variables of a directly manufactured material image.

title: Structured Bodies for Protein Chromatography
license: All rights reserved pending IP review
abstract: ChromStamp investigates designed flow paths and functional surface zones as an alternative to relying exclusively on random packed beds in protein chromatography.

title: Surrogate-Guided Aortic Flow and Material Design
abstract: Aorta connects vessel geometry, boundary conditions, hemodynamics, wall mechanics, material gradients, surrogate prediction, and experimental validation.

title: Cryo-EM and SAXS Fusion for Nanoparticle Surfaces
abstract: Nano Particle Surfaces combines Oracle-governed Cryo-EM morphology and SAXS ensemble constraints to reason about particle patterns and surface function.

title: Surrogate-Assisted Experimental Design for BMCA Methods
abstract: DOE · BMCA uses explicit factors, responses, constraints, uncertainty, and confirmation experiments to build a traceable surrogate-assisted design space.

title: Oracle, QTY, AlphaFold, and Experimental Evidence
abstract: The AlphaFold concept joins Oracle provenance, QTY hypotheses, an explicit external-service boundary, confidence interpretation, SAXS-surrogate comparison, and experimental decisions.

title: A Calibrated SAXS Surrogate for Structural Hypotheses
abstract: The SAXS surrogate learns calibrated relationships among scattering evidence, simulations, QTY and AlphaFold hypotheses, structural descriptors, residuals, and experimental feedback.

title: Unit-Aware Surrogate Modelling for Material Systems
license: All rights reserved pending IP review
abstract: Matomic describes a unit-aware material modelling loop with explicit boundary conditions, sensitivity, surrogate acceleration, applicability limits, and validation.
